THE LITTLE DETAILS

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Proposed program policies, explained.
No real membership or purchase terms.

How do I earn points?

The proposed rate is 1 point per $1 spent, with referral, review, social and seasonal bonuses. This page connects to no shop. Its review simulator awards 50 local sample points per eligible example product, once per session.

Do my points expire?

The proposed policy expires points after 12 months without activity, with a purchase or redemption resetting the clock. This local ledger has no automatic expiration job and resets on refresh.

How do I move to the next tier?

Calendar-year qualifying earned points determine the tier: Bronze 0–1,000, Silver 1,001–3,000, Gold 3,001–6,000, Platinum 6,001+. Redemptions do not reduce qualifying progress. The sample starts at 4,280 for 2026.

Can I combine points with other discounts?

The proposed policy allows stacking with sale prices and promo codes, except the VIP Shopping Event discount. No promotion validation, live checkout or transferable credit is connected.

How does the referral program work?

The proposed policy gives a friend $10 off and the member 500 points after an eligible first purchase, with no referral cap. The .example link is inactive; the baseline ledger includes seven credited referrals totalling 3,500 points.

What happens if I return an item?

The proposed policy reverses purchase earnings. A negative balance would be offset by future earnings. This preview does not accept purchases or returns and cannot change a real account balance.
